answer: Audits are published in mesa, queued in nadir, and inlet publishes the wait time. A farm of 82 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 24 identities per epoch. A farm of 2459 identities would post 1689 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
